parameters.name: BusinessType
parameters.description:
The log category. Valid values:

*   dcdn_log_access_l1 (default): access logs.
*   dcdn_log_er: Edge Routine logs.
*   dcdn_log_waf: firewall logs.
*   dcdn_log_ipa: TCP/UDP proxy logs.

parameters.name: FieldName
parameters.description: The log fields that you want to include in real-time logs to be delivered. Separate the log fields with commas (,).

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The website ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation.

parameters.name: TaskName
parameters.description: The name of the delivery task.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa update-site-delivery-task --task-name cdn-test-task --site-id 1234560000 --field-name ClientIP,UserAgent --business-type dcdn_log_er --discard-rate 0.0 --filter-ver example-string --region cn-hangzhou
